## Product and platform

Equal finished A/B envelopes; one approximately 7-inch flexible main OLED; flat storage in B; B moves upward 79.75 mm and seats normally by 8.20 mm; A has larger-cell priority. The 4700 mAh target uses cell-label sum at a common reference voltage; it is not verified terminal Ah for an unknown pack topology and is not a selected cell pair.

The implementation baseline is `a1b3cc1e0773446f2e36d0a607edf61211dd9919`. The donor reuse design decision and unknown physical identities are in [product interfaces](design/product_interfaces.json); project geometry and reservation assumptions are in [product geometry](design/product_geometry.json).

## Validation and research boundaries

Historical S4 D6 is the actual 36-suite/1654-test full-unit pass; R9 is not a new full software run. R9 freshly executes eight native finite factories/readers and reaudits two original R7 midtravel archives, preserving original inputs and named material identity. All ten finite states are clear under the original Common criteria; positive-axis gaps and native Common are counted separately. The original 16 conditional envelope gates and full independent proof reader pass within the original recorded budgets. Original numerical K products, correction history, H projections and five SHA-bound restore actions were actually read back; no new solver was run. ## Actual build and measurements

Formal collection on 2026-10-20 used the existing Pocket4 ADB service at 127.0.0.1:5061: 17 read-only commands succeeded, transport ID stayed 37, server boot/PID/start identity stayed unchanged, and source/design inputs matched exact f4db100. The imported record retains XT2551-3 only; ten other identity fields remain null, no seven-role physical inventory is supplied, and all 12 physical terminal interfaces remain unbound. ro.boot.hwrev is empty and is not converted into a board revision. Earlier software observations (3430/1140 mAh design values, 4570 mAh sum) and Chinese OEM manual values (4700 typical / 4540 rated mAh) keep their own dates and distinct scope. They do not prove the 4700-mAh layout. Actual board/module labels, dimensions, COF, cells/tabs/swelling, terminal topology, RF/thermal space and modified-phone measurements are still required. See engineering/product-integration-20261018/phase3-20261020/hardware/DONOR_IMPORT.md. This is recorded in engineering/engineering-integration-20261025/EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENT.json and does not invalidate the original donor observation. On 2026-10-26 the previously designated device endpoint again refused connection and adb was unavailable. New physical observations remain zero. The current input audit still finds ten unknown identity fields, seven physical part roles, twelve unbound OEM interfaces, 154 material entries without selected physical parameters and 13 load cases without sourced values. The current handoff and sampling/calibration/threshold requirements are in engineering/engineering-integration-20261026/physical/PHYSICAL_HANDOFF.md. Missing inputs retain unknown status. The later R5/R7 intake and handoff preserve 228 unique required facts: ten identity facts, 77 fields for seven part roles, 120 fields for twelve actual interfaces, and 21 selected-part revision facts. Of these, 207 require the same specimen and 21 the actually selected PN/revision. No qualified new specimen/OEM binding or physical G3/G4/G5 pass is recorded. The official XT2551-3 quick guide is model literature and supplies none of those bindings. The existing H00-H12 handoff is engineering/engineering-followup-20261028-r5/handoff/R5_EXTERNAL_BLOCKER_HANDOFF_V2.json. R8 changes entrypoint metadata only; it does not repeat a device-access attempt or create physical observations. R9 records no new physical measurement or qualified specimen/OEM binding. Official repair distribution routes and public L2/L3/BOM previews were located, but complete PDFs were not obtained; the visible USA BOM applies to XT2551-1/-2 and is not qualified for historical XT2551-3. The source/applicability record is engineering/engineering-followup-20261029-r9/real-sources/R9_OEM_SOURCE_APPLICABILITY.json.
